data.title: PM Surya Ghar Subsidy: A Complete Kerala Guide
data.excerpt: Everything Kerala homeowners need to know about the PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar subsidy.

children.text: Up to ₹78,000 central subsidy for rooftop solar.
Applies to residential connections in Kerala via the national portal.
Payback typically under 5 years with KSEB net-metering.
The PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana makes rooftop solar dramatically more affordable for Kerala households. This guide walks through eligibility, the subsidy slabs, and how to apply.
The subsidy is tiered by system capacity.
These amounts are credited after successful installation and inspection.
Most Kerala homeowners with a valid KSEB residential connection qualify.
Own the rooftop (or have owner consent).
Have a sanctioned residential KSEB connection.
Do not already have a subsidised system on the same connection.

data.warning: Subsidy slabs are revised periodically — always confirm current rates on the national portal before applying.
data.insights: Households that pair a 3 kW system with net-metering see the fastest payback in Kerala's tariff structure.
